gen-dafont-stencilia-gf-noto-sans-telugu: Cut-stencil drama, then quiet. Stencilia leaves gaps at its curve ends and does its best work loud, while Noto Sans Telugu keeps its midline high and its counters connected to the outside, built for steady reading.
gen-dafont-stencilia-gf-noto-sans-thaana: Noto Sans Thaana reads friendly and open, its lowercase forms big with wide channels running into each counter. And Stencilia, with its notched curve ends, gives a longer stretch of that plain sans something sturdy to sit beneath.
gen-dafont-stencilia-gf-noto-sans-thai: Noto Sans Thai fills its lowercase with swollen, bead-like shapes, rounded and left open, under a heading of cut stencil curves. Contrast is the draw.
gen-dafont-stencilia-gf-noto-sans-thai-l: Stencilia's curves break open at the ends. Noto Sans Thai Looped then lands underneath with tall bodies that look bold, and the stencil gaps give the heading a sharp, structural edge against that plain sans.
gen-dafont-stencilia-gf-noto-sans-tifina: Stencilia opens with structural, striking stencil cuts and a tight gap between x-height and ascender line. But Noto Sans Tifinagh softens everything below, its rounded lowercase bowls filling the line like inflated shapes.
gen-dafont-stencilia-gf-noto-sans-tirhut: Stencilia carves gaps into its curve terminals and keeps a compact span from x-height to ascender line. Big and brief is where it earns its place.
gen-dafont-stencilia-gf-noto-sans-ugarit: Stencilia brings cut, structural curves and a compact gap up to its ascender line. And Noto Sans Ugaritic follows with letter mouths left open like an unjoined chalk arc, so a longer stretch of it stays approachable.
gen-dafont-stencilia-gf-noto-sans-vai: Gaps open up at the curve ends of Stencilia, giving it a striking, structural look. But Noto Sans Vai sets its words as solid blocks rather than skylines, with generous space between each curve and its stem.
gen-dafont-stencilia-gf-noto-sans-vithku: Noto Sans Vithkuqi reads open and modern, with only a minimal step from capitals to lowercase. Stencilia earns its keep big and short, where its stencil gaps at the curve ends can really show.
